name: ocean
description: Oceanography: CTD casts, Argo and gliders, TEOS-10 and water masses, sections and T-S diagrams, transports and overturning, tides, eddies, SWOT, particles, marine heatwaves, blooms, mixed-layer budgets, cruise plans and regional model checks, through clio-kit's ocean server, with a provenance record for every result. It belongs to the Ocean analysis connector, which holds the optional NASA Earthdata Login for SWOT downloads: add it to a conversation while that connector is enabled. Gridded products come from the Copernicus connector when it is enabled, or from public servers that need no account.
